baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِن دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ joins acquisition, divine servanthood, displacement, and patronage.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward estimate authorizes a role transfer: people already belonging to God are deliberately made into alternative governors or protectors, even though مِن دُونِي marks them as other-than and lower than the displaced source.

activation_trace.role: Supposition and inward estimation frame the patronage arrangement as a mental calculation rather than a settled fact.
Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate appropriation and reassignment.
The owned-servant image keeps the proposed patrons inside God's possession, exposing the attempted transfer.
Otherness and lower rank make the new patronage a substitution beneath the source it displaces.
Taking charge of an affair gives the allies an assigned governing and caretaking function.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers wrongly choose servants of God as helpers instead of God.
changed_reading.after: They miscalculate that God's own dependents can be appropriated and promoted into an alternative structure of governance and protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rhetorical أَفَحَسِبَ is answered by إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا ... نُزُلًا: their estimate confronts a reception already prepared.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human reckoning is countered by prior divine readiness. Both packet mappings of ع ت د converge on preparation, while نُزُل turns hell into provision awaiting arriving guests; the threat is therefore an already stocked counter-arrangement, not merely a later penalty.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting supply the failed human reckoning that the second clause answers.
Present, close, and prepared supplies the immediacy of the divine counter-arrangement.
Preparing equipment or reserve supplies the stocked and purposive aspect of that arrangement.
Provision prepared for a guest casts the destination as a grim reception rather than an abstract punishment.
The repeated designation of those who block or deny truth identifies both the calculating agents and the recipients.

changed_reading.before: A mistaken belief is followed by a threat of hell.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages competing arrangements: their calculated patronage project faces God's already present, equipped reception for its architects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sensory closure and the later repeated ح س ب turn the focus estimate into a self-sealing evaluation loop: covering blocks remembrance and responsive hearing, while deliberate work can still be appraised from inside that enclosure as good making.

activation_trace.role: The focus supposition is the mistaken estimate whose production the context now exposes.
Covering supplies a focus-level image that the preceding literal covering makes perceptual and operational.
A literal screening cover supplies the enclosure that withholds corrective sight.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the unavailable corrective uptake.
The repeated inward estimate links the focus question directly to their later self-assessment.
Doing what is judged good supplies the positive verdict generated inside the closed loop.
Making as purposive work gives that mistaken verdict a concrete field of activity.

structural_cues: 18:101 immediately characterizes the group by covered eyes and unavailable hearing; 18:104 repeats ح س ب while their striving is lost and their making is self-rated good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, failed responsive hearing, repeated estimating, and self-approved making; I infer closure causes a self-confirming estimate, while the live alternative is that 18:101 merely describes, rather than causes, the error.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a false guess about who can serve as patron.
changed_reading.after: The patronage guess is one output of a closed evaluative system: excluded correction lets misdirected work and substitute loyalty continue to register internally as good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accounting branch of ح س ب becomes a failed ledger. Purposive works are entered as assets, but the sequence marks them as loss, collapse, and finally without weight; the prepared نُزُل reads as the settlement already positioned against that false balance.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting recast the opening question as an attempted valuation.
A present prepared outcome supplies the counter-entry already awaiting the failed valuation.
Prepared reserve supplies the sense that the settlement is provisioned rather than improvised.
Guest provision gives the settled account a concrete destination and allotment.
General diminution supplies the loss category under which the following works are audited.
Purposive action supplies the supposed assets being valued.
Falling and decline supply the collapse of those assets rather than mere subtraction from them.
Estimation by weight supplies the external measure under which their internal count reaches zero.

structural_cues: 18:103 opens an audit question about the greatest losers in works; 18:104 supplies their favorable self-estimate; 18:105 answers with collapsed works and no weight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies count, purposive work, loss, collapse, and weight; I infer a shift from subjective bookkeeping to an external measure, while the live alternative is ordinary moral evaluation without a sustained ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus opposes a mistaken affiliation to a subsequent punishment.
changed_reading.after: It opens an audit whose metric is wrong at source: self-counted assets become loss and zero weight, and the prepared reception is the resulting settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated form of اتخذ in 18:106 shows appropriation working by assigned complement: servants are made patrons in the focus, while signs and messengers are made mockery there. The final prohibition on partnership in worship closes the transfer route, leaving divine servants and messages unable to become rival functions.

activation_trace.role: Making something for oneself supplies the focus act of assigning God's servants a rival use.
Humble worship and obedience preserve the servants' proper relational direction toward God.
Love, support, and alliance name the rival function into which the servants are reassigned.
The repeated acquisition construction supplies a second visible act of functional reassignment.
Manifest signs supply divine material whose evidentiary function is reassigned.
Messenger and message supply another God-directed relation subjected to the same reassignment.
Mockery is the explicit replacement role imposed on signs and messengers.
Association with God explicitly names and prohibits the rivalizing operation.
Worshipful obedience restores the relation within which the focus servants belong.
Unity and singularity close the construction by excluding any co-recipient of worship.

structural_cues: 18:106 repeats اتخذ with a new object and an explicit predicative role, هُزُوًا; 18:110 ends the unit by forbidding any partner in the worship of one's Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated acquisition grammar, two imposed roles, and a final no-partner command; I infer a common mechanism of functional appropriation, while the live alternative treats patron-taking and mockery as separate offenses joined only by sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns selecting the wrong protectors.
changed_reading.after: It condemns a broader operation of seizing God-directed persons and signs and assigning them rival or nullifying functions: patron, mockery, or partner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hell is first exposed to view, then called prepared نُزُل in the focus; gardens later receive the same noun, followed by permanence and no desire for transfer. The repeated term is therefore a reception category whose value is supplied by destination and relation, not a positive hospitality word made negative only once.

activation_trace.role: Present readiness makes the adverse reception already available.
Prepared equipment and reserve make that reception deliberately provisioned.
Provision for an arriving guest supplies the shared reception category on the adverse side.
Displaying a thing for inspection makes hell the already exposed destination before it is named as reception.
The identical guest-provision branch supplies the favorable side of the paired reception.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the contrasting destination that gives this reception its positive value.
Stable endurance blocks any assumption that guest provision must be temporary.
No sought change of state or place supplies the permanence of the favorable reception.

structural_cues: 18:100 displays hell; 18:102 calls it prepared نُزُل; 18:107 repeats نُزُل for the gardens; 18:108 denies any desired transfer from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same noun at opposite destinations plus permanence on the garden side; I infer deliberate outcome-pairing, while the live alternative is two independent conventional uses whose contrast comes only from their nouns of place.

changed_reading.before: Calling hell نُزُل is a locally sarcastic use of a positive hospitality term.
changed_reading.after: نُزُل is the unit's neutral reception allotment: the host and destination determine whether arrival is exposure to hell or unexchangeable garden residence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hydrological holding-basin branch of ء خ ذ for a relational form and lets the nearby wave scene make the analogy visible. It remains anchored in the focus's taking, adjacency, preparation, and lodging, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of يَتَّخِذُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَّخِذُوا ... أَوْلِيَاءَ imagines taking close protectors into one's own arrangement, while أَعْتَدْنَا ... نُزُلًا announces the arrangement that actually holds the actors.

activation_trace.role: A basin that retains water supplies the exploratory image of trying to hold appropriated patrons inside a protective enclosure.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the tight adjacency imagined within that enclosure.
Interpenetrating wave-motion supplies the fluid field that activates the basin analogy.
Gathering dispersed elements supplies the reversal in which divine agency, not the patron-seekers, performs the effective containment.
A ready and present arrangement supplies the actual enclosure awaiting the would-be arrangers.
Prepared lodging gives that actual containment its destination form.

changed_reading.before: They construct a network of chosen protectors but are punished for it.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they imagine themselves holding a close protective reservoir; the sequence reverses agency as the surging multitude is gathered and the would-be containers are assigned God's prepared lodging.

strongest_changes: The repeated ح س ب converts a single false supposition into a self-sealing evaluative system that mistakes lost making for good work.
Loss, collapse, and zero weight activate the counting branch of ح س ب as a failed ledger whose settlement is already prepared.
Repeated اتخذ and repeated نُزُل reveal two structural reversals: divine persons and signs are assigned false roles, while the actors are assigned opposed reception outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The local packet makes 18:102 a hinge between closure and audit, and between attempted role assignment and actual destination assignment; the same compact ayah carries epistemic, administrative, accounting, and hospitality mechanisms without requiring them to collapse into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from sensory closure to favorable self-estimation is plausible but could be descriptive identification rather than production.
The paired نُزُل reading may be deliberate structural contrast or simply repeated conventional destination language.
The holding-basin outlier should remain exploratory because its value is analogical activation, not a claim about the contextual lexical sense.
